description: Crypto ticker / bid and ask: live best bid, best ask, last price and volume for one Coinbase product from Coinbase's Exchange data host, an independent second source to market.quote. Input: product_id such as BTC-USD. $0.02 per call. Returns: product_id, price, bid, ask, volume, time.

language.description: Optional BCP-47 language tag (en, ja, ko, pt-BR): the human-readable strings of the result (notes, details, reasons) are translated into this language; data, codes, numbers and URLs are untouched. Default: as produced.

name: hubvibe_market_ticker
title: Crypto ticker
